display_name: KraneShares China Technology & Semiconductor STAR 50 Index ETF

about.en: The KraneShares China Technology & Semiconductor STAR 50 Index ETF is a US-listed exchange-traded fund that tracks the SSE Science and Technology Innovation Board 50 Index of large Chinese technology companies listed on Shanghai's STAR Market. KSTR trades on NYSE Arca and represents a fund share, not an individual stock.
